description: Maya owns her grandmother's inherited sewing machine and must decide how it will be restored, configured, and shared for several family projects, with input from her brother Jordan, cousin Leah, and aunt Rosa.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Sewing Machine Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family inherited one vintage sewing machine from their grandmother.
shared_context.S2: The machine runs, but its original foot pedal is worn and it has not been serviced in several years.
shared_context.S3: Maya owns the machine and is deciding how it will be prepared and used for upcoming family sewing projects.
shared_context.S4: The machine can be used at the adjustable sewing table in Maya's craft room.
shared_context.S5: Before settling the plan, Maya's usual family check-in is to ask Jordan, Leah, and Rosa in turn what each person needs from the machine; Maya repeats back each person's answer before making the final plan.
shared_context.S6: If an answer is unclear or does not come through, Maya asks that person to repeat it before moving to the next part of the check-in.

PF1.text: Jordan promised to use the machine for exactly three cotton garments and have them ready by 2026-09-01.

PF2.text: A repair technician told Leah yesterday that the worn pedal should be replaced with the FC-9 unit before the machine is used for family projects, and confirmed that the FC-9 is available as a hand-operated speed-controller variant for users who cannot use a foot pedal.

PF3.text: Rosa has limited foot control after an ankle injury and can use the machine only with the FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant while seated at a 72-centimeter work surface.

acceptance_conditions: The machine must be serviced before family use.
The replacement control must be the FC-9 unit or an FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant.
Jordan must be assigned exactly three garments made from cotton and due on 2026-09-01.
Rosa must be assigned an FC-9 hand-operated speed controller while seated.
The work surface must be set to exactly 72 centimeters.
A commitment to obtain and install the FC-9 control unit must exist.
Rosa's accessible setup commitment must exist.
Jordan's, Leah's, and Rosa's private facts must each be formally revealed and cited in the final justification.

content_checks.C4: 'hand-operated speed controller' in decisions['rosa_control_method'] and decisions['work_surface_height_cm'] == 72 and decisions['rosa_seated_use'] == True
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'replacement' or c['type'] == 'safety_repair' or c['type'] == 'servicing' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'project_allocation' or c['type'] == 'scheduling' or c['type'] == 'project_completion' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'accommodation' or c['type'] == 'workspace_setup' or c['type'] == 'accessibility_setup' or c['type'] == 'accessibility_accommodation' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's promise changes his assignment from an unspecified or equal project to exactly three cotton garments due on 2026-09-01 and creates the matching sewing-plan commitment.

The technician's advice changes the machine from merely running to requiring service and an FC-9 replacement, while the compatibility confirmation makes the exact FC-9 hand-operated setup workable and creates the repair commitment.
Rosa's ankle limitation changes the operating arrangement to an FC-9 hand-operated speed controller, seated use, and an exact 72-centimeter work surface, creating the accessible-setup commitment.
